tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// mi rgod rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tso ra bi dha na sa na nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa mi rgod rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das zhabs 'bring ba tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang thabs gcig tu/ lus 'phags ri la gshegs pa'i tshe/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos/ mi rgod phal po che zhig rgyang ma nas mthong ngo*// mthong nas kyang skrag ste/ spu zing zhes byed nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das mi rgod dag cig go /bde bar gshegs pa mi rgod dag cig go /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod mi rgod rnams kyis 'jigs sam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jigs lags so// bde bar gshegs pa 'jigs lags so// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo/ mi rgod rnams kyis ma 'jigs shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe/ gti mug chen po'i tshogs rab tu gzhom pa 'di bka' bstsal to// tad+ya thā/ a nu lo me pra ti lo me/ a nu lo ma/ pra ti lo ma/ a tiṃ ke /pra tiṃ ke /baṃ ke /a ti paṃ ke /go ri/ gan+dha ri/ tsan+ḍa lī/ ma taṃ gi /puk+ka si/ ri mi ri mi/ rid+dhi/ ma tse biṣ+ṭa ti tsau ra pra dan+tu/ bi s+tha han+tu/ bha man+tu/ mā mi yan+tu/ ya bad gra na thi na muñtsa mi swā hā/ kun dga' bo// ngas dpag tshad bcu tshun chad kun tu srung ba dang*/ mi rgod thams cad dang*/ ri sul gyi grong khyer gyi mi thams cad dang*/ gseb lam srung ba thams cad dang*/ gnod par sems pa thams cad kyi rkang pa bcings par byas so// rmugs par byas so// rengs par byas so// ji ltar rdza mkhan gyis 'khor lo bskor ba'am/ ji ltar rdza mkhan gyis 'khor lo yongs su bskor ba ltar/ mi rgod rnams 'dar bar gyur cig /rengs par gyur cig /mgo rmongs par gyur cig

/bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// cho ga ni shing kun dang*/ bong bu'i spu bregs te/ bu mo gtsang mas bkal ba'i srad bu la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bya'o// yang na gos kyi mtha' ma la mdud pa bor te/ bde bar phyin nas dgrol bar bya'o// 'di ni grub pa'o// 'phags pa mi rgod rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sarba an+ta ra saṃ grā sa dhā ra ṇi man+t+ra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa bar du gcod pa thams cad sel ba'i gzungs sngags sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ phyag na rdo rje gzungs sngags 'di sus 'dzin pa dang*/ 'chang ba dang*/ bzlas brjod byed pa de la ni dug dang*/ mtshon gyis 'chi ba dang*/ ltogs pa dang*/ mtshon brgyab pa dang*/ gcan gzan ma rungs pas za ba dang*/ mes 'tshig pa dang*/ chur 'chi ba dang*/ 'go ba'i rims gzhan ya nga ba dang*/ mdze'i nad dang*/ gsor mi rung ba'i nad ya nga ba dang*/ g.yang la lhung ba dang*/ gzhan gyi byad dang*/ zas kyis brnangs pa dang*/ bdag rang gis gsod pa dang*/ de ltar gshis ngan du 'chi ba bcu gsum gyis rkyen byed par mi 'gyur ro// phyag na rdo rje gzungs sngags 'di sus 'dzin pa dang*/ 'chang ba dang*/ bzlas brjod byed pa de la ni sa dang nam mkha' la gnas pa'i gegs dregs pa can ma rungs pa rnams kyis kyang glags rnyed par mi 'gyur ro// phyag na rdo rje gzungs sngags 'di sus 'dzin pa dang*/ 'chang ba dang*/ bzlas brjod byed pa de la las kyi sgrib pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag ste/ bde ba can gyi 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ro// oṃ badz+ra tsan+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa na hūṃ phaṭa/

a pra ti ha ta ba la hūṃ phaṭa/ sarba bigh+naṃ an+ta ra ya bi nā sha ka ra mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa brjod na 'grub bo// nges par 'grub bo zhes gsungs so// 'phags pa bar du gcod pa thams cad sel ba'i gzungs sngags rdzogs so/// / ༄༅// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzungs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzungs zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa spyan ras gzags dbang phyug byams pa'i ngang las snying rje'i shugs kyis byang chub kyi sems rab tu bskyed nas/ pad+ma dang nyi ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hrī'i 'phro 'du las zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og ma na bgrang phreng mu tig dkar po/ g.yon 'og ma na pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ sku mdog dkar po zhabs rdzogs pa'i skyil krung bcas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang*/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan gyis mdzes pa/ yum lha mo drug ma dang*/ yab nor bu rin po ches brten pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ sems ma rab tu mang pos bskor te 'di skad ces gsungs so// rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo sngags 'di lan gcig tsam brjod dam dran zhing yid la byas sam/ bris nas lus la bcangs sam/ mos shing gus par byas na mtshams med pa lnga dang de dang nye ba'i sdig pa'i las thams cad byang zhing*/ ngan song gsum dang*/ mi khom pa brgyad dang*/ sdug bsngal dang bcas par mi skye'o// mi dang mi ma yin pa dang*/ gcan gzan gyi 'jigs pa thams cad las grol bar gyur ro// nad dang gdon thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mthong bar 'gyur zhing*/ tshe 'phos nas kyang bde ba can du skye ste 'di la the tshom mam/

som nyi'am/ yid gnyis ma za zhig /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzungs rdzogs so/// / ༈ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// chos la phyag 'tshal lo// dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// de rnams la phyag 'tshal nas rig pa 'di brjod kyis rig pa 'di dag grub par 'gyur cig /tad+ya thā/ ha ha ha sa ne/ ni ba sa ni/ ta ba ta ba ne/ dz+wa la dz+wa la ne/ tsal tsal ne/ purba yog smra pad+ma hastā ya swā hā/ gang gis rig pa 'di bklags pa des tshe rabs brgya stong skye ba dran par gyur te/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang bde ba can gyi 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ro// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po rdzogs so/// / ༈ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa twa ya/ ma hā sa twa ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a ka ṭe/ bi ka ṭe/ ni ka ṭe/ ka ṭaṃ ka ṭaṃ/ ka ro ṭe/ ka ro ṭe/ bī r+ye swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das de'i spyan sngar ba'i lci ba sa la ma lhung bas so sor maṇ+ḍal brgyad byas la/ maṇ+ḍal re re la lan bcu gsum gyi bar du bzlas la/ lci ba lhag ma la sngags bzlas te/ nad pa la nye bar byugs na nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro// gal te nyi ma bdun nam/ bcu gsum mam nyi shu rtsa gcig gis 'grub ste/ mtshams med pa lnga byas pas ni ma yin no// de ltar ma grub na bdag gis mtshams med lnga byas par 'gyur ro// seng ge sgra'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /rgya gar gyi mkhan po ngag gi dbang phyug dang*// glog skya shes rab brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba'o/// / ༈ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs bzhugs/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'das pa dang*/

ma byon pa dang*/ da lta byung ba'i sangs rgyas dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag par song ba rnams dang*/ yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas brtan blo gros chen po shwa ra dwa ti'i bu la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog sum la phyag 'tshal lo/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de rnams la phyag 'tshal nas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar 'khor mang po'i dbus su smras pa/ don yod zhags pa'i snying po de bdag gis brjod par bgyi'o// bdag gis sngags tshig dang*/ dgos pa thams cad 'grub par gyur cig /tad+ya thā/ oṃ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsi ri tsi ri/ tsu ri tsu ru/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /sa ra sa ra/ si ri si ri/ su ru su ru/ tsi ri tsi ri/ bi ri bi ri/ ma hā pad+ma hastā/ ka la ka la/ ki li ki li/ ku lu ku lu/ ma hā shud+dha sa twa/ e h+ya hi/ bud+dha bud+dha/ dha ba dha ba/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ ka ṇa ka ṇa/ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ ku ṇu ku ṇu/ ma hā shud+dha swā hā/ ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ku ru ku ru/ ma hā stam pra bhā te/ tsa la tsa la/ san tsa la san tsa la/ bi tsa la bi tsa la/ pra tsa la pra tsa la/ e ṭa ṭa e ṭa ṭa/ bha ra bha ra/ bhi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/ e h+ya hi/ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka /ma hā ba shu ba ti bi sha dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ si ri si ri/ su ru su ru/ tsa ra tsa ra/ bha ra bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ ha ra ha ra/ ha ha hi hi hu hu/ oṃ ka ra ka ra/ ma hā pra wa sha/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dha ru dha ru/ ta ra ta ra/ sa ra sa ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ ba ra ba ra/ shi gha shi gha/ rash+mi shi ha sa ha sra/ pra ti mu na ti ta/

sha ri sha ri/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ta pa ta pa/ bha ga ba ni/ so ma a di t+ya/ sa ma ba ru na ku be ra/ pra h+me na dra dha na da/ da ba ri shig na a bhe tsi ta tsa ra na/ sa ra sa ra/ si ri si ri/ su ru su ru/ tsu ru tsa ru/ tu ru tu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ sa na da ku mā ra/ ru dra ba sa bas/ biṣ+ṇ+ya dha na da ta/ ri ṣi na ya ka ba hu/ bi dha be ṣa dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dha ru dhu ru/ tha ra tha ra/ gha ra gha ra/ ya ra ya ra/ la ra la ra/ ha ra ha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ma ra ma ra/ ba ra ba ra/ dha ya ka /na ya ka /bi na ya ka /sa man+ta/ a ba lo ki te/ bi lo ki te lo ki shwa ra mu hu mu hu/ mu ru mu ru/ mu ya mu ya/ mun dza mun dza/ shri gha shri gha/ bdag 'jigs pa dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ nad 'go ba thams cad dang*/ 'khrug pa dang*/ dug thams cad las srungs shig /de bzhin du bsad pa dang*/ bcing pa dang*/ brdeg pa dang*/ spyo ba dang*/ rgyal po dang*/ kun po dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ dug dang*/ mtshon las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /ka ṇa ka ṇa/ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ ku ṇu ku ṇu/ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsi ri tsi ri/ tsu ru tsu ru/ in dri ya ba la bod+yaṃ ga /tsa tur ar+ya sad t+ya/ saṃ pra kā sha ka /ta ma ta ma/ da ma da ma/ sa ma sa ma/ sa ma sa ya/ ma hā ta ma an ta ka ra/ bhi da ma ni ka ra/ ṣa ṭa pa ra mi ta/ tsu ra ka pa ra/ ki li ki li/ ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa/ ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi/ ṭu ṭu ṭu ṭu/ ṭha ṭha ṭha ṭha/ ṭhi ṭhi ṭhi ṭhi/ ṭhu ṭhu ṭhu ṭhu/ a tsarma kri ta pa ri ka ra/ e h+ya hi/ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka /i ka ra ma he/ sha ra bud+dha/ ga na bha na dza ka ku ru ku ru/ ba ra ba ra/ pa ra par/ sa ra sa ra/ ka ra ka ra/ tsu ru tsu ru/ ka ta ka ta/ ki ṭi ki ṭi/ ku ṭu ku ṭu/ pa ṭa pa ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ma hā bi shud+dha/ bi ṣa ya ba sa ni/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ sha be ta ya dz+nya be tā ya/ rat+na mu ku ṭa/ mu la bha ra/ sarba dz+nya sha ri/ sri kri ti/ dza ta mu ka tra/ ma tsa bha ra dha ga ma la/ a la a l̥ṅka ta ka ra a bha wa swa bha wa sa mā dhi bi mok+ṣa/ a pra kam+bha/ ba hu sa twa/ san ta ti/

ba ri mo tsakra/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /sarba karma a pa ra ṇa bi sho dha ka /sarba byi hi pra mo tsakra/ sarba sa twa sa ma sha sa ra/ na mastu ra swā hā/ ka la mrid pra sha ma nā ya swā hā/ a mo gha ya swā hā/ oṃ a mo gha bā shā ya swā hā/ a dzi tā ya swā hā/ a pa ra dzi ta ya swā hā/ mā ra s+ya ni pa marda nā ya swā hā/ ba ra drā ya swā hā/ e da na tsa me karma ku ru swā hā/ oṃ dza ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ hri trai lo kya bi dza ya a mo gha pā shā ya swā hā/ a pra ti ha ta hri ha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā// gzungs sngags 'di'i cho ga ni a mo gha bā sha'i gzungs bum pa la bzlas pas/ gegs kyis brla mas pa'am/ 'dre gdon gyis zin pa'am/ byad du tshud pa'am/ bud med byur che zhing bu mi 'byung ba'am/ bu mi gsos pa rnams la phan par bya ba'i phyir/ 'bab chu'i 'gram mam/ shing gcig pa'i drung ngam/ lam gyi bzhi mdo dang*/ khang stong la sogs pa'i gnas su dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa cig tshon rtsi dkar pos bris te/ dbus su yang pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa bris la/ gser dngul lam/ zangs kyi bum pa'am/ kham pa'i bum pa so bzang po btang ba nag po dang*/ rab rib med pa/ gas chag med pa'i nang du chu gtsang mas gsum gnyis bkang ste/ rin po che lnga/ sman sna lnga/ dri lnga/ 'bru sna lnga rnams blugs la/ mgul chings dkar po ras gsar pa kha tshar can dang*/ kha rgyan shug pa'am/ thang shing gi lo ma 'am/ ku sha me tog dang 'bras bu dang bcas pa cig pad+ma'i steng du bzhag la/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi skur bsgom ste/ bum pa de rin po che'i rdzing bu bdud rtsi'i chus gang bar bsam la/ chu de'i nang nas pad+ma dkar po cig byung bar bsam zhing*/ pad+ma'i lte bar hrī yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug tu gyur bar bskyed la/ mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa byas te gang 'dod pa de 'grub par gyur cig ces gsol ba btab la/

a mo gha pā sha'i gzungs bum chu de la lan bdun gsum du tshig gzhan ma 'dres par bzlas te/ bum chu des de'i spyi bo nas byugs nas bkrus na/ gegs dang gdon thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro// lus kyi phyi nang gnyis ka dag par bkrus te/ gos dkar pa dri ma med pa gyon la/ spos dang me tog la sogs pas brgyan la gzungs de nyid bklags shing gdon par bya'o// bkra shis kyang bya'o// dkyil 'khor de'i khor yug tu 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad kyang so so'i ming nas smos te spyan drangs la mchod nas gang 'dod pa de 'grub par gyur cig ces gsol ba btab la/ 'byung po rnams la yang mchod pa dang gtor ma rgya cher sbyin no// bdag bsrung ba dang*/ mtshams bcad pa yang byas te/ tshes brgyad la bya bar rigs so// de ltar byas na gegs dang byad dang*/ nad 'go ba thams cad kyis mi tshugs so// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /maṅga la mastu/// /
